realized_metrics.window_convention: WP-12aw / WP-S2c-14 uses the next prior contiguous equivalent-length non-cloned evaluation window, 2023-04-12 through 2024-04-11, as the first additional H-001 exp_success_criteria observation after the original full-period no-formal-split baseline. Indicators are warmed up on prior available history, but the backtest window starts flat with no pre-window position carry-in. The original H-001 REP-0002 evidence used a full-period retrospective posture, so strict non-overlap against that baseline is impossible; this package follows the later repo precedent of explicit non-cloned window disclosure for additional REP evidence.

metric_comparisons.comparison_notes: EXP-0002 requires OOS Sharpe >= 1.0 net of modeled costs; OL-0018 records sharpe below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires dsr_val > 0.95; OL-0018 records dsr below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires max drawdown <= 20%; OL-0018 records max_drawdown above that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires parameter sensitivity min_ratio >= 0.70; OL-0018 records sensitivity_min_ratio below that threshold.
EXP-0002 requires walk-forward efficiency > 0.5; OL-0018 records walk_forward_efficiency below that threshold.

interpretation: REC-0029 derives from OL-0018 and is the WP-S2c-16 H-001 exp_success_criteria cycle 1 REC for the A2C-001 first-member runway. It is the second REC observation for the exact segment H-001 / research_oos / pre_wp_5b / exp_success_criteria, increasing the exact segment count from 1 to 2. It does not satisfy REC-5 and does not floor-cross the segment. Cost-drag is preserved but not deterministically compared because OL-0018.metrics.gross_pnl <= 0 makes cost_drag_fraction semantically uninterpretable as a pass/fail ratio. REP-0018 and OL-0018 liquidation and zero-equity facts are evidence facts only and do not create kill, archival, demotion, or lifecycle authority.
